module: Data logging controller template (type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 100000): every frame it appends to an in-memory CSV (csvlib library) time, throttle, brake, stored energy of the electric batteries and power of the electric motors. saveLogToCSV writes the "testLog" file. To be copied as a starting point for a custom logger.
notes: No jbeam key is read. The timer is incremented by update(dt); csvData:write('testLog') writes the file without an explicit extension (csvlib behavior).
The power is outputTorque1 * outputAV1 (W) summed over the devices of type "electricMotor".

init.desc: Creates the CSV (columns time, throttle, brake, batteryCapacity, motorPower) and resets the timer to 0.

reset.desc: Recreates an empty CSV and resets the timer to 0.

updateGFX.desc: Adds a data row to the CSV.

saveLogToCSV.desc: Writes the CSV to disk under the name testLog.
